text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — I opened PR #8239 (hotpatch) to adjust the alloc timeout heuristic. Canaries are mostly green but I see a small p95 bump on the 4k-seq benchmark. I plan to merge in ~1h if no blockers. Please ping if you want more data.

Tom: Can you paste the canary numbers here? how big is the bump?

Aisha: Sure, pasted below from the canary run (4k seq, 1000 samples):
```
baseline p50  22.4ms  p95  128.7ms p99  310.2ms
patch    p50  22.6ms  p95  145.3ms p99  318.9ms
median token throughput: baseline 380 tok/s, patch 377 tok/s
mem (rss): baseline 6.3G, patch 6.4G
```

Ravi: +1 to wanting the perf harness raw logs. p95 jumped ~13% which is annoying but p99 is flat. can you also share the microbench for small-batch (batch=1, seq=512)?

Aisha: Added microbench for small-batch:
```
small-batch (1x512): baseline p95 11.1ms patch p95 12.0ms
alloc churn samples show a handful of 1-2ms spikes at prefill step under the patch
```

Ben: Hmm those prefill spikes sound like alloc contention. Did you try the alternative patch that reduces lock scope (the other commit in draft)?

Aisha: I did a quick try — alternative reduced the p95 back to 129ms but increased mem by ~200MB. Tradeoff.

Tom: Any test failures or canary regressions flagged by the rollout monitor?

ci-bot: All unit/integration tests for PR-8239 passed. Canary rollout: 5/5 healthy endpoints. Observability alert: p95_longseq increased by 11% on canary group — flagged for review.

deploy-bot: Canary run artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/8239/canary-artifacts (bench csv + flamegraphs).

Ravi: If the patch regresses p95 but p99 is stable, and small-batch impact is minor, I'd consider merging with a short-lived canary in prod and quick rollback window. But we should add an SLO guard to the rollout config.

Ben: +1 to the SLO guard. Also can we add a metrics snapshot before and after merge for the next rollout? makes postmortem checks quicker.

Aisha: Will add SLO guard and the snapshot step. Question for timing: can someone give a quick thumbs up if they're fine with merge in 45m? I want to avoid leaving this hotpatch dangling overnight.

Tom: My +1 is conditional on the SLO guard and snapshot. please paste the exact config diff so I can quick-review.

Aisha: diff is tiny, pasted:
```diff
- prefill_lock_timeout = 20ms
+ prefill_lock_timeout = 8ms
```
Also adding rollout config:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary_percent: 10
  slo_guards:
    - metric: inference_p95_longseq
      window: 10m
      threshold_pct: 105
      action: rollback
  snapshot: true
```

Ravi: That rollout looks reasonable. small canary + auto rollback at 105% p95. +1

Ben: Approved for merge after SLO guard added. +1

Tom: LGTM after config included. +1

Aisha: Thanks all. I'll push the SLO guard commit and queue the merge in 35m. Will post the prod canary link once live.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 2026-03-18T22:05:00Z for PR-8239.

Aisha: CI run for SLO-guard commit completed, merging now. Notifying on rollback channel if anything spikes.

ci-bot: Merge completed. Release id: r-2026-03-18-8239. All tests green.

Tom: Thanks — keeping an eye on dashboards.

Ravi: I'll watch p95 closely for the next 30m and report if we cross threshold.

Ben: if we start seeing >110% on p95 i'll open a rollback PR immediately.

Aisha: Appreciate it. Will follow up with a short postmortem if we see any noisy regressions. :pray:
